title: Interactive embedding valuation sketch
content:
Goal: quick proto for per-embedding unit economics + starter tier ideas for interactive retrieval use-cases. Keep assumptions explicit so we can swap numbers for different infra / model choices.

Topline assumptions (baseline model + infra):
- Model: embed-small (768-d) FP16 execution path, optimized kernels, runs well on A100-like slice.
- Effective batch size in production: 256 embeddings/batch for realtime bulk + 1–8 for low-latency interactive calls. We mix both.
- Observed median batch latency: 50 ms for 256 (forward + memory overhead) -> ~20 batches/sec.
- GPU hourly cost (amortized infra + ops + utilization): $3.00/hr baseline (includes packaging of instances, networking, ops).
- Storage cost (S3 standard): $0.023/GB-month. Persist vectors as float16-ish (~1.5 KB/vector after quant/packing).
- ANN index (faiss/hnsw) CPU/RAM amortized cost: assume $0.00002/query for lookups on plausible scale (back-of-envelope).

Throughput math (production efficient path):
- embeddings/sec = batches/sec * batch_size = 20 * 256 = 5120 embeddings/sec.
- embeddings/hour = 5120 * 3600 = 18,432,000 embeddings/hr.
- GPU cost per embedding = $3 / 18,432,000 = $0.000000163 (~1.6e-7).
- GPU cost per 1k embeddings = $0.000163.

Add other per-call costs (interactive mix):
- Networking/CPU overhead + infra ops & queuing + logging = estimate $0.00005 per 1k embeddings (tiny).
- ANN retrieval cost per user query (single query returning top-k): $0.00002 per query (assumed).
- Storage amortized per embedding/month = 1.5 KB = 0.0000015 GB -> cost = 0.0000015 * $0.023 = $3.45e-8/month -> negligible per call.

So fully loaded cost (one-off inference + infra) per 1k embeddings: ~0.000163 (GPU) + 0.00005 (infra) = ~0.000213 -> call it ~$0.00022/1k. Add margin and product costs.

Pricing heuristics (quick proposals):
1) PAYG (for small customers / trials): $0.50 per 1M embeddings = $0.0005/1k (2–3x markup from loaded cost). Simple, easy to present.
   - Rationale: simple to compare vs competitors, leaves room for promo credits.
2) Starter / Developer tier (monthly): $20/mo includes 50k embeddings + additional at $0.00045/1k.
   - Effective included value to encourage experimentation. 50k freebies maps to tiny infra cost but sticky UX.
3) Scale / SaaS: commit tiers by monthly embeddings (e.g., 5M / 50M / 500M) with stepped discounts. e.g., 5M at $0.00035/1k, 50M at $0.00018/1k, 500M negotiated ~cost+margin.
4) Interactive low-latency premium: +20–30% surcharge for pinned low-latency SLA (hot path, small batch provisioning). Because LC path reduces batching efficiency -> adjust model of GPU cost per embedding. Example: if pinned small-batch lowers efficiency by 4x then GPU cost/1k rises from 0.000163 to ~0.00065/1k. Apply surcharge so price ~0.0009/1k in low-latency add-on.

Credit packaging idea (hybrid):
- Provide "embedding credits" in subscription bundles: 1 credit ~= 1 embedding (or fractional mapping for combined features). Credits consumed by embed calls + search queries (search = embed + ANN) -> bill search as 1.2 credits to account for lookup cost.
- Starter: 50k credits, rollover 30 days. PAYG customers consume direct $/embedding after credits.

Examples (customer back-of-envelope):
- SMB Search app: 2M embeddings/month. If PAYG@0.0005/1k -> cost = 2,000 * 0.0005 = $1.00/month (this highlights the sensitivity — double-check units!) WAIT — sanity check: 2M embeddings = 2000 * 1k, so 2000 * $0.0005 = $1.00. That seems extremely low. Re-check: that implies embedding calls are cheap per our loaded cost. So pricing should be higher to represent product value.
  - Alternative normative pricing: $5 per 1M embeddings ($0.005/1k) -> 2M => $10/mo. That's easier to reason about and covers ops, support, and margin.

Key friction / realism checks (open questions):
- Our baseline GPU cost assumption ($3/hr amortized) is critical. If infra is $12/hr for certain instance types, per-1k numbers multiply by 4. Need sensitivity table.
- Small-batch interactive path efficiency drag — measure empirically. We need real batch distribution heatmaps from serving telemetry.
- How many embedding calls are deduplicated / cached? Cold vs warm cache rates matter a lot for unit cost.
- Cross-sell: charge embedding generation separate from vector search? Or bundle them (search cost = embed + ANN + margin)? Simpler UX says bundle search as single unit.

Packaging experiments to run (MVP):
- Run A: PAYG only (announced price $5 / 1M embeddings) + starter credits $20 incl 4M embeddings for trial (aggressive). Measure conversion.
- Run B: Subscription first: $29/mo includes 5M embeddings + 100k chat tokens. Overlap with chat billing edge-cases need gating.
- Run C: SLA premium: test with 2–3 beta customers on pinned small-batch capacity priced as +50% premium. Track actual GPU inefficiency.

Notes-to-self / TODOs:
- Pull real telemetry: distribution of batch sizes, per-batch latency, GPU utilization from serving-runtime/metrics (ask SRE). (Jira: INF-4231)
- Run quick cost sensitivity script: vary GPU/hr = [$1.5, $3, $6, $12] and batch_size = [1,8,64,256] -> produce table of cost/1k. (GH: redwood-infra#2347)
- Decide conversion point to bundle search vs bill embed+ANN separately. Talk to sales/solutions for enterprise use-cases where search is core.
- Define recommended public price range: low-end $0.005/1k (intro), target $0.02/1k (value capture) — empirical A/B.

Loose intuition summary (for internal use):
- Absolute infra cost per embedding is tiny at scale (orders e-4 per 1k) if we can fully batch. Product value and simplicity justify pricing in the $0.005–$0.02/1k band.
- Latency-sensitive interactive use-cases materially increase unit cost; surfacing a latency premium or packaging pinned capacity is cleaner than per-call dynamic surcharges.
- Storage costs are negligible per vector but index/ANN CPU costs + real-time mem/disk footprints should be part of tiering considerations (hot vs cold index).

Quick table to paste into slides (rough):
- Loaded cost per 1k embeddings (fully batched): ~$0.00022
- Loaded cost per 1k (small-batch/pinned): ~0.0009–0.0010
- Suggested public price (PAYG): $0.005/1k (intro) -> $0.02/1k (standard)
- Starter subscription: $20–29/mo with 2–5M included credits (trial focused)

Random thoughts:
- Could experiment with "embedding packs" sold as $/pack of 100k with expiry to capture mid-market customers who dislike subscriptions.
- For large customers, better to sell committed capacity (dedicated pools) and meter at cost+ (simpler SLO alignment).
- Consider "query-level" tier: bundle n embeddings per search and sell search as higher-value unit for enterprise search customers.

End. Feel free to ping me if you want a sensitivity spreadsheet; next step is to ingest real billing/telemetry and produce the small table for growth to use in pricing deck.

-- AM
